name: West Central Tree Service

items.title: The homepage is heavy on a phone
items.detail: The homepage is about 4.7 MB on a phone, mostly photos, where fast sites stay under 3 MB.
items.fix: Resize and compress the photos (and load the ones further down only when needed), so the page opens fast on cell data.

items.title: No quote form on the homepage
items.detail: There's no quote form on the homepage, so people have to find your Contact page first.
items.fix: Three quick questions on the homepage, and every answer goes to your phone in seconds.
items.fixTitle: Add a short quote form up top

good: Has a search description for Google
